checkpoint_policy.before_replacement: Record root-owned 0600 metadata and exact bytes for every existing dormant target; unexpected custody fails closed.
checkpoint_policy.for_absent_targets: Record root-owned absence evidence; rollback may remove only targets proven absent before staging.
checkpoint_policy.uncertain_state: Retain checkpoint and failure evidence; do not retry or delete uncertain state.

compatibility.baseline_rule: Compatibility is proven against the actual installed baseline through a clean temporary PYTHONPATH; no newer Lab Hours core, CLI, reservation, runner or manifest file is installed or imported as a dependency.

validation.imports: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m unittest -q test_sa3_listener_adapter.py test_aster_llama_sa3_guest_wrapper.py test_sa3_expanded_quality_transaction.py
validation.platform_suite: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B -m unittest -q test_lab_hours_reservations.py test_lab_hours_reserved_runner.py test_lab_hours_workloads.py test_lab_hours_dispatcher.py test_lab_hours_doctor.py
validation.required_result: All imports, custody checks, packet pins, excluded-file checks and inactive-unit checks pass; no core upgrade, bytecode, unit, timer, booking, lease, process or model request is created.

rollback.host: Stop before any live effect, verify installed dormant hashes, restore only the checkpointed dormant targets atomically, remove only targets recorded absent, and rerun the compatibility postcheck.
rollback.guest: Verify installed runtime/wrapper hashes, restore only the LXC110 checkpointed targets atomically, remove only targets recorded absent, and rerun the import/custody postcheck.
rollback.prohibited: Do not replace the live CLI, reservations, runner, manifest, guardian or runtime; do not stop/start a service, change a timer, acquire a lease, book Lab Hours, drain production, invoke a model, alter routing, reboot, or delete uncertain state.

prohibited_effects: Lab Hours booking or window check
